enforced: noArmor and chatRate are enforced (both are absolute, a dropped packet is harmless to the bot: armor is also refused at the equip action, a dropped chat line is only a line). The rest stay in log mode until gate-log.json is clean of stray call sites. GATE=log forces everything to log mode.
note: The rules of play as data. brain/gate reads this file; it is meant to become the one place a rule lives (docs/HILLCLIMB-INSIGHTS.md items 3 and 8). mode: off | log (record every violation with its call site, let the packet through) | enforce (drop the packet and record it).

noArmor.liftedBy: ALLOW_ARMOR=1 in the environment or brain/safety/gear.allowArmor = true (the flip happens when the bots have diamond gear with Mending)

minToolTier.note: stone is the default; a higher tier only when the block requires it (iron for diamond/gold/redstone/emerald, diamond for obsidian). Violation: the held pickaxe/axe/shovel outranks what the block needs AND a tool of a sufficient lower tier is in the bag.

permit.note: rule 3 of the shared world: no digging or placing unless asked or part of an agreed job. A dig/place with no job running and no explicit permit is a violation. LOG until gate-log.json shows which stray call sites need a permit (escapes from a buried head, lava, a flooded pit), then enforce.

lavaWalk.note: never move with a lava bucket selected

torchSpacing.note: torches at least 2 air apart (distance 3 between torch cells)
